_readme: A verified, working Higgsfield provider definition for RenderPost's aggregator framework (see docs/BEHAVIOR_MAP.md §3.11 and the 'Connect providers' settings panel). This exact definition ships built into RenderPost.py's PROVIDERS dict (Flare/Sunburst/Seedance counterparts to the fal models, connect/disconnect like any other provider) — this file exists as a readable reference and as a template for adding another provider (e.g. Artlist, Nim.video) the same way. Every endpoint, field name and response shape here was confirmed live against the real Higgsfield API on 2026-09-29 (Dynamic Client Registration, a real image edit, and a real image-to-video generation — not guessed from documentation). Uses mcp_http so generation draws on an existing Higgsfield subscription's credit pool, not a separate paid API balance (api.higgsfield.ai is billed separately from any subscription; mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp is not). A catalog entry that routes to this provider should also declare its own "variant" field ("flare" or "sunburst") — the {variant} placeholder below is filled from that, not hardcoded, so two catalog entries can share this one provider definition and still pick different underlying variants.

verified_2026-09-29: Dynamic Client Registration against https://clerk.higgsfield.ai/oauth/register — requires a User-Agent header or the request gets a 403
media_import_url response shape: {media_id, type, content_type, source_url}
generate_image_batch submit response: {jobs: [{index, job_id, status}], submitted_count, failed_count} — note job_id is nested under jobs[], not a top-level id

jobs_wait response once terminal: {jobs: [{..., status: "completed", result_url: "..."}], all_terminal: true} — result_url sits directly on the job for both image and video, no separate show_generation_by_ids call needed for a headless pipeline

gpt_image_2_5's medias role is exactly "image_references" (for both the main image and an optional second reference — the schema only documents one role name, used for both slots); seedance_2_5's image-to-video role is "start_image" with mode "omni_reference" — these differ per model, always confirm with models_explore before assuming a role name

gpt_image_2_5 cost: 1 credit at medium/2k (~$0.03 on an Ultimate plan). seedance_2_5 cost: 35 credits at 5s/720p (~$1.05), scale roughly linearly with duration/resolution — re-check with get_cost before trusting these numbers on another plan tier
not_verified: The character-reference (second medias entry) path specifically — the conditional two-image steps above were verified with a fake/mocked MCP session (confirms the request shape sent is correct), not against the real Higgsfield API. A real generation with two reference images hasn't been run yet.
Whether client_id from Dynamic Client Registration needs any cleanup/expiry on Higgsfield's side after repeated connects — each connect registers a fresh client
